activation_policy: EVERY candidate here is status=under_review and needs_reviewer=true. None of these may be written into tax_rules with status='active'. Activation requires a verified official_source AND an approved tax_rule_reviews row with a licensed reviewer, per server/lib/taxGate.js. Values marked confidence=low were read from DJP guidance page summaries, NOT from the primary regulation text, and must be confirmed against the PMK/PP.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: the obligation exists and its amount
evidence_rule_candidates.notes: NEEDS OFFICIAL SOURCE for any legally-required field list. Fields above are product requirements, not law.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: VAT was charged and is potentially creditable
evidence_rule_candidates.risk_if_missing: input VAT may not be creditable
evidence_rule_candidates.notes: Required-field list must come from the PER on faktur pajak — NOT yet sourced. GAP.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: tax was withheld and by whom
evidence_rule_candidates.risk_if_missing: counterparty cannot credit the withheld tax; the withholder cannot evidence remittance
evidence_rule_candidates.notes: Coretax bukti potong manual (DJP_BUPOT_001) is the best operational source found; read it before defining fields.

evidence_rule_candidates.risk_if_missing: an invoice proves the obligation, never the settlement
evidence_rule_candidates.notes: NEEDS OFFICIAL SOURCE. Currently a product/accounting-control requirement, not a cited legal one.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: the movement as recorded by the bank

evidence_rule_candidates.notes: PMK 168/2023 and BPJS forms both bear on required payroll data; neither has been read.

evidence_rule_candidates.what_it_proves: the rental relationship, period, and base rent
